name: Tour Operator ERP Platform
description: Covers the ERP-style software platform that tour operators, group and coach travel providers, tailor-made travel specialists, destination management companies, and travel agencies run their business on: travel product and contract management, visual tour building and quoting, bookings and departures, group operations such as seat allocation, room lists and guide assignment, supplier and reseller portals, real-time bookable customer websites, traveler portals and apps, payments, invoicing, accounting and guarantee-fund compliance, marketing, quality, and business intelligence across the Benelux and wider European travel trade.
